name: Set Chat Permissions
description: Set default chat permissions for all members. [See the docs](https://core.telegram.org/bots/api#setchatpermissions) for more information

configurable_props.name: chatId
configurable_props.label: Chat ID
configurable_props.description: Enter the unique identifier for the target chat (e.g. `1035597319`) or username of the target public chat (in the format `@channelusername` or `@supergroupusername`). For example, if the group's public link is `t.me/mygroup`, the username is `@mygroup`.

configurable_props.name: canSendMessages
configurable_props.label: Send text messages
configurable_props.description: If the user is allowed to send text messages, contacts, locations and venues

configurable_props.name: canSendMediaMessages
configurable_props.label: Send media messages
configurable_props.description: If the user is allowed to send audios, documents, photos, videos, video notes and voice notes

configurable_props.name: canSendPolls
configurable_props.label: Send polls
configurable_props.description: If the user is allowed to send polls

configurable_props.name: canSendOtherMessages
configurable_props.label: Send other messages
configurable_props.description: If the user is allowed to send animations, games, stickers and use inline bots

configurable_props.name: canAddWebPagePreviews
configurable_props.label: Add web page previews
configurable_props.description: If the user is allowed to add web page previews to their messages

configurable_props.name: canChangeInfo
configurable_props.label: Change info
configurable_props.description: If the user is allowed to change the chat title, photo and other settings. Ignored in public SuperGroups

configurable_props.name: canInviteUsers
configurable_props.label: Send invite users
configurable_props.description: If the user is allowed to invite new users to the chat

configurable_props.name: canPinMessages
configurable_props.label: Pin messages
configurable_props.description: If the user is allowed to pin messages. Ignored in public SuperGroups
